securityNotes: Read SKILL.md, README.md, reference.md and package.json in full at the pinned commit. No scripts, no network calls, no credential access, no download-and-execute, no hidden or exfiltration-style instructions. The skill documents an optional third-party Claude Code plugin (0xdesign/design-plugin, kylezantos/0x-designer-plugin) as one of two paths but does not require installing it -- path B is a fully self-contained manual playbook usable in any IDE without that plugin. All temp-artifact cleanup instructions (remove .claude-design/ and __design_lab route) are ordinary housekeeping, not exfiltration.

proposedEntry.name: design-and-refine
proposedEntry.description: Runs a Design & Refine workflow that explores a UI concept as several genuinely different, runnable code implementations (not static mockups) rendered side by side at a dev-server comparison route, then folds in the user's per-variant feedback through iterative synthesis rounds, and finalizes into persistent DESIGN_PLAN.md (implementation steps, accessibility checks, testing notes) and DESIGN_MEMORY.md (style decisions for future sessions) while cleaning up temporary lab routes and files. Offers a Claude Code plugin path and a self-contained manual playbook for Cursor or other IDEs that detects the project's framework and styling system before generating variants.
triggers: explore layout options for this page
compare a few directions for this component
inputs: component or page to design or redesign
a running dev server on a supported web stack
outputs: several distinct runnable UI variant implementations
a side-by-side comparison route in the dev server
